a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost guarantees we both fail (about 1% chance of 3 storm-free rounds). I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly instead of doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end short, so if you'd rather go first, say so and I'll reconsider. After that I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I told you I would. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If the split left me with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
